1. Put the item in the bag. Clean and straighten the open end of the bag to remove dust and smooth out wrinkles or ripples

Stage 1: in the budding stage, before the teeth grow out, the baby already feels uncomfortable on the gums. The gum of the first stage can be put in the refrigerator, and the cool touch can relieve the swelling and pain of the baby's gums before teething.
Stage 2: at the age of 6 months, most babies begin to grow a pair of incisors in the lower jaw. At this time, frozen gums massage soft incisors should be used to relieve discomfort; Hard gums can massage pulp, and uneven gum surface will also stimulate the development of baby's brain.
Stage 3: When the baby grows four upper and lower teeth, it is recommended to choose pacifier chewing gum which is similar in shape to pacifier, lighter in weight and easier to grasp. The soft and hard texture layer can not only massage the pulp around the newly grown teeth, but also let the baby experience the feeling of chewing.
The fourth stage: 1-2 years old. 1-2 years old is the growth period of deciduous teeth. Select the fixed teeth gums that can reach a wide range of teeth and have baffles to prevent contact with the throat.
